title: Black History Presentation
text: Since this is the first show during Black History Month, we wanted to take a moment to talk about some of the great African-American entertainers who have contributed to the legacy of Saturday Night Live. From Garrett Morris to Eddie Murphy to Ellen Cleghorn and so many more, representing black culture has always been a part of Saturday Night Live's DNA. Whether it was Billy Preston's musical performance in the first episode... Or Richard Pryor's unforgettable job hosting in season one...
